# CaniUAV — Industrial UAV Accessories & Custom R&D

> High-performance UAV components and custom engineering services by CANI Technology. 37W high-power VTX, COFDM digital HD links, EO/IR gimbals, flight controllers and ESCs, ELRS receivers, AI vision modules, and full OEM/ODM engineering.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Industrial UAV components manufacturer — 37W VTX, digital HD links, AI guidance modules. 200+ patents, ISO-certified, NDAA-compliant.
- [About CANI](/about): National High-Tech Enterprise founded 2015, specializing in industrial UAV core component R&D. Deployed in 30+ countries.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales (so_0307@qq.com) and tech support (support@caniuav.com) for OEM/ODM, 37W VTX integration, EO/IR gimbal support.
- [News](/news): Industry news, technical analysis, and product announcements from CANI Technology.

## Products

- [Product Catalog](/products): Full catalog of industrial UAV components and turnkey systems.
- [UAV Platforms](/products/multi-rotor): Tethered, cargo, swarm, and industrial FPV drone platforms.
- [Accessories Overview](/products/accessories): Digital FPV, FC/ESC, gimbals, ELRS, VTX, cameras.
- [Digital FPV Video Transmission](/products/accessories/fpv): 1080P HD COFDM digital link, 30ms latency, 50km range, AES-256-GCM encrypted.
- [Gimbal & Pods](/products/accessories/gimbal): IP67 tri-axis stabilized gimbals with IR + RGB dual-sensor fusion; DJI PSDK and MAVLink.
- [High-Power VTX](/products/accessories/vtx): Analog 2.5W–37W video transmitters with up to 50km line-of-sight.
- [Flight Controller & ESC](/products/accessories/fc-esc): Industrial FC/ESC combos with dual-redundancy IMU, DShot, MIL-STD-461G certified.
- [ELRS Control System](/products/accessories/elrs): ExpressLRS long-range control links, sub-millisecond latency, FHSS.
- [Cameras](/products/accessories/camera): Action and FPV cameras for aerial photography and inspection.
- [Tethered Drones](/products/tethered): Continuous-flight tethered systems for surveillance, comms relay, emergency lighting.
- [Logistics Drones](/products/logistics): Cargo delivery UAVs for remote, island, and mountainous terrain.
- [Drone Airport](/products/airport): Automatic drone docks for unattended operations and data management.
- [Drone Swarm System](/products/swarm): Multi-drone swarm coordination for formation flight and collaborative missions.

## Custom R&D Services

- [Custom Accessories R&D](/custom-research/accessories): PCB layout, firmware, structural design, extreme-environment testing. 30-day prototypes.
- [Custom Drone R&D](/custom-research/drone): 150kg heavy-lift, 30-day tethered (500V HVDC), AES-256 MAVLink 2.0, Level 8 wind resistance.
- [Custom Software R&D](/custom-research/software): Custom GCS, MAVLink optimization, ≤30ms latency, edge AI (YOLOv8), RTK/PPK.
- [Custom Payload R&D](/custom-research/payload): EO/IR, LiDAR, gas detection, logistics drop, BVLOS comms. PDK dev kit.
